The side navigation works well too — picking "Read later" from the left took me to the same focused queue, and having it sit there permanently down the side is nice because I can always see it's an option no matter where I am.

Honestly, either placement is fine by me, so I'll lean on what tends to grow. I suspect this app is going to end up with a few of these "places" — all my bookmarks, read later, and probably a spot for things I've set aside — and a list down the side feels like it'd hold that growing set of destinations more comfortably than a row of tabs that could get crowded. So if you're asking me to pick, I lean slightly toward the side navigation for that reason.

But it's a mild preference, not a requirement — the tabs were perfectly clear too. What matters to me is that the Read Later place is easy to get to and stays distinct; both do that. Side navigation is my gentle pick.
